user_problem: Teams have approved messages but lack a coherent order for a focused landing page.
unique_output: A section-by-section message sequence linking visitor question, approved claim, evidence asset, and call to action.
test_case: Sequence eight supplied messages for one audience while rejecting two claims that exceed the evidence provided.
overlap_to_check: General frontend design, campaign briefs, and claim-evidence mapping.
specific_guardrail: Produce content sequence only, no HTML/UI/SEO performance prediction. Retain supplied evidence restrictions and CTA authority; unsupported promise is a gap, not rewritten as fact.
